protocol: Full 216-case matrix and 216 E5 clips per version; same native controls, no per-note gain. Second-vs-first deltas are measured; listener judgment remains required.
spectral_method: Welch Hann, at most16384 samples/50% overlap, mean L/R power; partial bands +/-max(bin width, 1.5% partial frequency). Native levels and powers remain unnormalized.

native_outputs.verification: Each fresh render validates frame count, all float samples, and non-silence; native metrics count full-scale samples.

PCM16_outputs.verification: Generator validates native samples and the shared ceiling before quantizing; all playback files use the same scalar.

ctest.reported_by: Parent integration run after final second-pass build

construction_level_calibration.reported_by: Parent integration run after final second-pass calibration

validation.javascript_syntax: node --check passed for generated three-version player

tradeoffs.G4: Every microphone G4 case reduces upper-partial/fundamental ratio, while sustained RMS varies across construction/style. Close Mic Finger median +0.172 dB, Thumb +0.358 dB, Pick -0.683 dB relative to First pass; Mono Mic ranges are available per style below.
tradeoffs.E4: Some E4 changes are small: the least changed Close Mic upper-partial/fundamental ratio is -0.006 dB, compared with stronger A4/B4/E5 reductions.
tradeoffs.physical_decay: The capture refinement retains physical strings/bridge/radiation poles; it does not establish that the remaining perceived banjo cue is gone.

reproduction.core_command: python3 Tools/CompareConstructionResonance.py --renderer baseline=BEFORE --renderer candidate=FIRST_PASS --renderer second_pass=SECOND_PASS --output build-resonance/evidence/construction --jobs 4 --no-wav
